basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old gamer living in Austin, Texas. I recently got into 'Breath of the Wild' and love exploring the vast world it offers. I'm a software developer by day and enjoy gaming in my free time. I'm single and love spending evenings online, usually between 8 PM and midnight. Aside from gaming, I'm passionate about self-improvement, evident in my journey to stop drinking and maintain fitness.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong foundation in technology and software development, thanks to my computer science degree and five years in the tech industry. My interest in gaming has led me to learn game mechanics through online tutorials and community discussions.
